description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Greater Louisville market (bi-state KY/IN). Structure follows the live-market precedent; every value is re-derived from this market's own committed artifacts and none is copied -- in particular none from the retired 001 contract, which describes a 130-identity census this market no longer has.
status_note: Live: this contract gates the assembly of a PUBLISHED market. It grants no deployment -- publication is a state of the source and deployment is a separate act recorded in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations/.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held or superseded identity leaks and every gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization, and PTF-LOUISVILLE-PUBLICATION-008 deployed nothing.

provenance.publication_schema_work_order: PTF-ST-LOUIS-PUBLICATION-SCHEMA-DECISIONS-010, re-affirmed for this market by PTF-LOUISVILLE-PUBLICATION-008: 23 rows publish an unqualified blanket maximum as operator=lte scope=per_pet, and one fee cap publishes qualifier_stated=false, meaning THE SOURCE STATED NO FURTHER QUALIFIER and never that none exists.
provenance.superseded_note: None. No Louisville signature was withdrawn or superseded.
provenance.held_note: None. The market held one identity at PTF-LOUISVILLE-FOUNDER-REVIEW-004 -- Candlewood Suites Louisville South Fair and Expo -- and the founder released it at 006 on two agreeing strong signals: an exact street address and the IHG property code sdfpp, carried by the captured document's own canonical link and by an independently sourced census URL.
provenance.name_corrections: Ten census identities publish under the name their own page states, through launch_packages/pettripfinder/markets/name_corrections/louisville-ky.json. Eight of them were bare chain words; the routes follow the corrected names, so no profile publishes at a chain-named URL.
provenance.identity_confirmation: The Hampton Inn and the Home2 Suites at 1150 Forest Bridge Road are two hotels, not one: the pages state Building B and Building A and carry different Hilton property codes (sdfhuhx, sdfehht), each captured from its own property-specific URL. Confirmed by the founder in PTF-LOUISVILLE-PUBLICATION-008 so no gate re-asks it.

identity_census.note: The 166-identity census was rebuilt by PTF-LOUISVILLE-MARKET-REBUILD-002 on the generic discovery path over 18 bounded cells across Kentucky and Southern Indiana. It is the denominator every number below reconciles against, and no publication step edits it.

reconciliation.note: verified_no_pets counts ONLY VERIFIED_NO_PETS records this market owns. unresolved is UNKNOWN and never negative evidence. PTF-LOUISVILLE-PROMOTION-AND-APPLICATION-002 promoted the reader-validated rows from PTF-LOUISVILLE-PARALLEL-REVALIDATION-001 -- 7 pet-friendly and 3 verified-no-pets -- moving published 46 -> 53, no-pets 17 -> 20, resolved 63 -> 73 and unresolved 103 -> 93. The census did not move: this order promoted policy, not membership. Four rows the revalidation called clean are HELD because the committed policy reader would not derive their pets_allowed.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Records 47-53 were appended by PTF-LOUISVILLE-PROMOTION-AND-APPLICATION-002 and each carries its own approval block naming that order; the original 46 are byte-identical to the ones the founder signed at PTF-LOUISVILLE-FOUNDER-FINAL-006.
policy_package.replaces: The 14-record package this path carried from the retired 001 build. That package described a market of 130 identities and was never published.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing page, nearby-lodging cards, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links and /go/ interstitials. This market's seed inventory is derived one row per approved record, so a held, refused or SUPERSEDED property has no inventory row to leak -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/louisville-ky/. Four of its eighteen configured corridors reach their own configured minimum and claim a route; the rest claim none. The market and its corridors stay hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false), the posture the market contract carries and the one Pittsburgh and St. Louis launched with. The routes themselves are live and directly reachable.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
